page.overview:
Who is TECHNIC Figure?

8222 V-TOL 8223 Hydrofoil 7 8225 Road Rally V / Super Kart 8229 Tread Trekker 8230 Coastal Cop Buggy / Miami Police Patrol 8232 Chopper Force 8233 MC Vs. Stinger 8235 Front End Loader 8239 Cyber Slam Spider 8244 Convertables 8245 Robot's Revenge 8248 Forklift 8250 Search Sub 8252 Beach Buster 8253 Fire Helicopter 8257 Cyber Strikers 8268 Scorpion Attack 8269 Cyber Stinger 8299 Search Sub8299 Search Sub w/CDROM 8305 Duel Bikes 8307 Stunt Race 8463 Forklift Truck 8620 Snow Scooter 8640 Polar Copter 8660 Arctic Rescue Unit 8680 Arctic Rescue Base 8712 TECHNIC Figures 8714 The LEGO TECHNIC Guys

TECHNIC Figures are figures that appeared in TECHNIC sets, especially from the CyberSlam/Competition line. They were first introduced in 1986 in the Arctic Action line. They are much larger than the standard minifigures (hence their alternative nickname "Maxifigure") and have several more joints, including bendable elbow and knee-joints, which are absent on normal minifigures. Each figure starts off fully assembled and they are not meant to disassembled, but the parts are not fixed can be pried loose by pulling at them with sufficient force. Their increased size means that they can connect to both standard LEGO System bricks and on TECHNIC parts, and their hands are large enough to fit TECHNIC pegs.

TECHNIC Figures have not been produced since 2001 but they have several descendants in the form of the Belville Figure, the 4+ Figure and the Mini-doll Figure.
